metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2005 · Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
metas.description: Charlie, a young boy from an impoverished family, and four other kids win a tour of an amazing chocolate factory run by an imaginative chocolatier, Willy Wonka, and his staff of Oompa-Loompas.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2005 · The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
metas.description: While playing, Lucy and her siblings find a wardrobe that lands them in a mystical place called Narnia. Here they realize that it was fated and they must now unite with Aslan to defeat an evil queen.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2006 · Night at the Museum
metas.description: A newly recruited night security guard at the Museum of Natural History discovers that an ancient curse causes the animals and exhibits on display to come to life and wreak havoc.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2000 · How the Grinch Stole Christmas
metas.description: On the outskirts of Whoville lives a green, revenge-seeking Grinch who plans to ruin Christmas for all of the citizens of the town.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2004 · The Polar Express
metas.description: On Christmas Eve, a young boy embarks on a magical adventure to the North Pole on the Polar Express, while learning about friendship, bravery, and the spirit of Christmas.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2008 · The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
metas.description: The Pevensie siblings return to Narnia, where they are enlisted to help ward off an evil king and restore the rightful heir to the land's throne, Prince Caspian.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2004 · A Series of Unfortunate Events
metas.description: When a massive fire kills their parents, three children are delivered to the custody of cousin and stage actor Count Olaf, who is secretly plotting to steal their parents' vast fortune.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2009 · Night at the Museum: Battle of the Smithsonian
metas.description: Security guard Larry Daley infiltrates the Smithsonian Institution in order to rescue Jedediah and Octavius, who have been shipped to the museum by mistake.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2007 · The Golden Compass
metas.description: In a parallel universe, young Lyra Belacqua journeys to the far North to save her best friend and other kidnapped children from terrible experiments by a mysterious organization.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2001 · The Princess Diaries
metas.description: Mia Thermopolis has just found out that she is the heir apparent to the throne of Genovia. With her friends Lilly and Michael Moscovitz in tow, she tries to navigate through the rest of her sixteenth year.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2003 · Freaky Friday
metas.description: Dr. Tess Coleman and her daughter, Anna, do not get along with each other. However, things take a turn when, in a freak accident, they switch bodies and are forced to live each other's lives.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2008 · Marley & Me
metas.description: A family learns important life lessons from their adorable, but naughty and neurotic dog.

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 2007 · Evan Almighty
metas.description: God contacts Congressman Evan Baxter and tells him to build an ark in preparation for a great flood.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2006 · Monster House
metas.description: Three teens discover that their neighbor's house is really a living, breathing, scary monster.

metas.name: ★ 5.4 · 2002 · Scooby-Doo
metas.description: After an acrimonious break up, the Mystery Inc. gang are individually brought to an island resort to investigate strange goings on.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2007 · Mr. Bean's Holiday
metas.description: Mr. Bean wins a trip to Cannes where he unwittingly separates a young boy from his father and must help the two reunite. Along the way, he discovers the wonders of France, bicycling, and true love.

metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2008 · Journey to the Center of the Earth
metas.description: On a quest to find out what happened to his missing brother, a scientist, his nephew and their mountain guide discover a fantastic and dangerous lost world in the center of the earth.
